about.title: About the 30th Celebration set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration marks 30 years of Pokémon. The set has 191 cards: 128 main set cards, including 30 special Pikachu Rares; 30 secret rares (18 Illustration Rares, 10 Special Illustration Rares and 2 Futuristic Rares); 30 Classic Collection reprints of iconic cards from the game’s history; and the 3 ultra-rare RGB Mews.

This checklist’s Grand Master set also has every other card with the 30th Celebration logo: 17 promos from 30th Celebration products and the 27 First Partner promos (also listed in ME Black Star Promos), the 8 Basic Energy (also in ME Energy), the Cosmos Holo Eevee from the Knock Out Collection and 2-Pack Blister, 10 stamped prints from events and shops, and the 27 stamped foils from other sets in the Espeon ex and Umbreon ex Battle Decks. Promos and Energy marked here are marked in their own lists too.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 128 main set cards), the Master set (188 cards, adding the secret rares and the Classic Collection) or the Grand Master set (all 281 cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
